verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a cloud platform that agents operate, so the axis applies. The evidence shows agent authentication through the CLI or OAuth, MCP setup, and copying local coding-agent credentials to cloud agents. None of it documents issuing scoped, least-privilege tokens (for example per-project or permission-limited) for an agent, so this is lack of evidence for an applicable capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
